name: rnw-components-test
description: Verification harness for @superloomdev/rnw-components: unit, purity, accessibility, docs and browser gates, plus the roster and icon generators that read the pinned upstream packages.

scripts.bundle: npm run manifest --silent && npx esbuild harness/entry.js --bundle --format=esm --outfile=harness/bundle.js --platform=browser --alias:react-native=react-native-web --alias:node:module=./harness/node-module-stub.js --alias:@react-native/assets-registry/registry=react-native-web/dist/modules/AssetRegistry/index.js --resolve-extensions=.web.js,.js,.json --define:process.env.NODE_ENV=\"development\" --define:global=globalThis --define:__DEV__=true --log-level=warning && npx esbuild harness/reference-entry.js --alias:@carbon/themes/src/g10.js=./harness/upstream-theme-g10.cjs --alias:@carbon/themes/src/g100.js=./harness/upstream-theme-g100.cjs --bundle --format=esm --outfile=harness/reference-bundle.js --platform=browser --alias:react-native=react-native-web --alias:node:module=./harness/node-module-stub.js --alias:@react-native/assets-registry/registry=react-native-web/dist/modules/AssetRegistry/index.js --resolve-extensions=.web.js,.js,.json --define:process.env.NODE_ENV=\"development\" --define:global=globalThis --define:__DEV__=true --log-level=warning
scripts.test:browser: npm run bundle && npx playwright test
